name: tmux
why: Backbone of the work/personal session workflow.

name: neovim
why: Primary editor; new APIs often unlock kickstart.nvim improvements.

name: fzf
why: Powers fuzzy history/file search and the radar TUI itself.

name: ripgrep
why: Default code search for you, Neovim (Telescope) and coding agents.

name: fd
why: File finder behind Telescope and fzf pickers.

name: jq
why: JSON swiss-army knife for API, kubectl and gh output.

name: uv
why: Python packaging and envs; ships workflow-changing features often.

name: gh
why: GitHub issues/PRs from the terminal; used by agent skills for the issue tracker.

name: kubectl
why: Cluster access; new versions change flags and deprecate APIs.

name: helm
why: Chart deployments; major versions change chart and plugin behaviour.

name: alacritty
why: Terminal emulator; releases can change config keys in alacritty.toml.
